summary.abstract: ALSPAC questionnaire data based on answers from the mother and partner about pregnancy, birth, health, environment, feelings and beliefs, from pregnancy to the child's first birthday. Sample record: wave metadata is described in CLOSER Discovery.
summary.description: Questionnaires completed by the mother and her partner during pregnancy and the child's first year. Variable-level documentation, questions and summary statistics for this wave are held in CLOSER Discovery (see the wave identifier).
summary.shortTitle: ALSPAC Pregnancy, Birth and Infancy (pregnancy to 12 months)
summary.title: ALSPAC Pregnancy, Birth and Infancy (pregnancy to 12 months)

waveOf.title: Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children (ALSPAC)

wave.label: Pregnancy, birth and infancy (pregnancy to 12 months)

recruitment.samplingMethod: Population-based: all eligible pregnant women in the study area were invited to take part.

followUpSchedule.note: Mothers, partners and children have been followed up through questionnaires and clinic visits since recruitment.

eligibility.inclusionCriteria: Pregnant women resident in the former county of Avon with an expected delivery date between 1 April 1991 and 31 December 1992.
